_comment: Tracks upstream sources so sync-upstream.py can auto-update this fork. Add an entry to vendoredSkills whenever a new skill is vendored in from a repo other than the main fork upstream.

fork.description: This whole repo is a fork of coreyhaines31/marketingskills. Syncing it is a standard fetch+merge from upstream/main.

vendoredSkills.description: Vendored from a separate repo (not part of the fork relationship) because it isn't part of marketingskills upstream.
